title: The Cost of Knowing
work: The Three-Body Problem by Liu Cixin, translated by Ken Liu
kind: original thematic cipher companion; not a reconstruction of the novel

states.claim: Detecting or estimating an actor need not disclose your location
Receiving a signal is not transmitting one; source must still be checked
Outbound signaling actively discloses an intended message; no receiving or reply is guaranteed
A warning is testimony, not a guaranteed verified forecast
Homeostatic non-engagement is a legitimate choice

boundary: The score is not a measured probability of extraterrestrial interception. Trisolaran triple-star system is not the separate Sag A*/Nib Sun/Sol mnemonic.
